name: Library Integrity & Downloads Runtime Hardening
changes: Flags identical media fingerprints assigned to different episodes of the same TV title when they are separate physical files, while leaving one shared multi-episode file informational.
Adds a production regression guard built from 29 exact historical false-positive TV releases retained in v3.6.47 diagnostics, plus the Love Island: All Stars companion-show identity pattern.
Reduces Downloads polling pressure from 4 Hz to 2 Hz while queue/post-processing work is active, 0.8 Hz when the Downloads page is idle, and about 0.67 Hz outside the visible Downloads page.
Widens the coherent Downloads snapshot cache from 0.22s to 0.40s so nearby UI/diagnostic callers reuse one authoritative presentation instead of forcing redundant rebuilds.
Adds split snapshot telemetry for SAB/reconciliation time, provider-health time, and derived remaining NewzDeck presentation time so future slow-build diagnostics identify the real phase.
Clears the transient SAB Queue/History reader-busy last_error after a fresh Queue+History pair succeeds, while retaining existing contention counters/telemetry.
Refreshes UPDATING.txt so newly built packages no longer ship the stale v3.6.20 update description.
Preserves v3.6.47 Selected Episodes, PAR2/repair visibility, SABnzbd 5.1.2, v3.6.46 quality-aware selection, scan progress, Smart Import, and strict TV identity behavior.
regression_guards: The existing production identity/Library Integrity/scan/quality/Selected Episodes/PAR2 repair guard remains mandatory and is updated only for the 3.6.48 adapter/runtime identity.
A new v3.6.48 regression guard rejects 29 exact historical false positives from the 2026-09-07 diagnostics and a representative Love Island: All Stars / The Morning After mismatch.
Synthetic Library Integrity coverage requires separate same-title cross-episode duplicate files to need review and requires one shared multi-episode file path to remain informational.
Downloads runtime source guards require the adaptive polling cadence, 0.40-second coherent cache, split snapshot phase telemetry, and recovered reader-busy last_error semantics.
The GitHub release workflow runs both the established validator and the v3.6.48 supplemental regression validator before building release artifacts.
